title: Sync lifecycle coordinator and version seam
summary: Post-pilot #499 slice: AppStore facade delegates lifecycle state and transport boundary to one observable coordinator. All merge/account/epoch/persistence logic retained, guarded by whole-file inverse hash. Incoming payload adapter accepts legacy or explicit v1 and rejects future/malformed versions. No outbound schema rollout or server migration. Full merge extraction and versioned writes remain follow-ups. Native qualification UNRUN.
